class.name: IfcProcedure
class.brief_description: An IfcProcedure is a logical set of actions to be taken in response to an event or to cause an event to occur. HISTORY New entity in IFC2x2 IFC2x4 CHANGE ProcedureType renamed to PredefinedType and made optional (upward compatible). Where rules WR1 and WR2 have been removed. Use definitions IfcProcedure is used to capture information about stepped processes such as calibration, start/stop procedur

members.member: Identifies the predefined types of a procedure from which the type required may be set. A String, one of the enumeration's values, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
